title: Stick to Your Choice
simplified_paragraphs: 从前有三个兄弟想从农村到城市去创造自己的事业，他们克服许多困难后终于来到了一座热闹的小镇。这里有三条路，其中只有一条能到达城市，但谁也说不清究竟哪条才是。他们各自选了一条路走了，30年后两个哥哥依旧留在贫穷的山村，而最小的弟弟却拥有了自己的公司。原来他们选择的三条路都非常艰难，充满各种挑战和痛苦。两个哥哥怀疑自己选择的路，所以遇到困难后就不能继续坚持，而小弟始终记着一位长者的话"走自己认为是对的路”。他相信自己的选择，所以坚持到了最后。
其实，每条路都能通向城市，走自己认为是对的路，并且坚持下去，你一定能获得成功。
traditional_paragraphs: 從前有三個兄弟想從農村到城市去創造自己的事業，他們克服許多困難後終於來到了一座熱鬧的小鎮。這裡有三條路，其中只有一條能到達城市，但誰也說不清究竟哪條才是。他們各自選了一條路走了，30年後兩個哥哥依舊留在貧窮的山村，而最小的弟弟卻擁有了自己的公司。原來他們選擇的三條路都非常艱難，充滿各種挑戰和痛苦。兩個哥哥懷疑自己選擇的路，所以遇到困難後就不能繼續堅持，而小弟始終記著一位長者的話"走自己認為是對的路”。他相信自己的選擇，所以堅持到了最後。
其實，每條路都能通向城市，走自己認為是對的路，並且堅持下去，你一定能獲得成功。

qí shí， měi tiáo lù dōu néng tōng xiàng chéng shì， zǒu zì jǐ rèn wéi shì duì de lù， bìng qiě jiān chí xià qù， nǐ yī dìng néng huò dé chéng gōng。
english_paragraphs: Once, three brothers left the countryside for the city, hoping to build businesses of their own. After overcoming many difficulties, they finally reached a bustling town. Three roads led out of the town. People said only one reached the city, but no one knew which one it was. Each brother chose a different road. Thirty years later, the two older brothers were still living in poor mountain villages, while the youngest had a company of his own. As it turned out, all three roads were difficult, full of challenges and hardship. The older brothers doubted their choices, so they gave up when they ran into trouble. But the youngest never forgot an elder’s advice: “Follow the path you believe is right.” He trusted his choice and kept going to the end.
In fact, every road could lead to the city. Follow the path you believe is right, and keep going. You are sure to succeed.

Three roads led out of the town. People said only one reached the city, but no one knew which one it was. Each brother chose a different road. Thirty years later, the two older brothers were still living in poor mountain villages, while the youngest had a company of his own. As it turned out, all three roads were difficult, full of challenges and hardship. The older brothers doubted their choices, so they gave up when they ran into trouble. But the youngest never forgot an elder’s advice: “Follow the path you believe is right.” He trusted his choice and kept going to the end.

In fact, every road could lead to the city. Follow the path you believe is right, and keep going. You are sure to succeed.
